from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/inputs/report.html')
dst=Path('/work/report.html')
b=src.read_bytes()
needle=b'</head>'
idx=b.find(needle)
if idx==-1:
    raise SystemExit('No </head> tag found')
if b.find(needle, idx+1)!=-1:
    raise SystemExit('Multiple </head> tags found; refusing ambiguous edit')
insert=(
    b'    <meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview)">\n'
    b'    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n'
)
out=b[:idx]+insert+b[idx:]
dst.write_bytes(out)

# Verification
written=dst.read_bytes()
assert written==out
# verify unchanged outside insertion
reconstructed=written[:idx]+written[idx+len(insert):]
assert reconstructed==b
# verify one description and one robots meta with name attr
text=written.decode('utf-8')
print('description meta count:', text.count('name="description"'))
print('robots meta count:', text.count('name="robots"'))
print('insert_index:', idx)
print('output_bytes:', len(written))
# show context around insertion
start=max(0, idx-80)
end=min(len(text), idx+len(insert)+80)
print('\n---context---')
print(text[start:end])
